\begin{tabular}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{2.0cm}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{4.45cm}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{4.3cm}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{4.5cm}@{}}
\toprule
Quantity & Image diffusion & Text reconstructor & Trained MDLM \\
\midrule
Data draw & Images sampled from a distribution & Independent sources supplying token chunks & The same source-disjoint A/B corpora \\
Corruption & Additive Gaussian noise, variance $\sigma^2$ & Hidden-token probability $q$ & Absorbing token masks, evaluated at $q=0.5$ \\
Data summary & Empirical mean $\widehat\mu$ and covariance $\widehat\Sigma$ & Unigram $p$, lag counts $N_{n,\delta}$, and conditional rows & Parameters learned from the complete visible chunk \\

Population target & Variation over training datasets & $\Dbar^{\rm lag}_{n,q}$ over source collections & $\Dbar^{\rm MDLM}_{n,q}$ with shared training randomness fixed \\
Common input & Noisy input or initial sampling noise & Identical text and mask & Identical text, mask, and diffusion time \\
Analytic object & Covariance spectrum and random-matrix fluctuation formulas & Source-count covariance or multinomial row variance & Observed A/B disagreement, with no neural forecast asserted \\
Scope of comparison & Denoisers, sampling maps, and neural outputs & One-step reconstruction scores & One-step token probabilities \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}
